faqs.question: What is the minimum order quantity (MOQ) and unit price for Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins?
faqs.answer: The starting wholesale MOQ for Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins is 300 pcs. Reference factory-direct tiered pricing is $1.35/pc (300 pcs starter tier), $0.78/pc (500 pcs tier), and $0.52/pc (2,000+ pcs volume tier), depending on size and finish complexity.

faqs.question: What is the mold or tooling fee for Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins, and when is it waived?
faqs.answer: Tooling policy for Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins is $65 Die (Waived @ 500+ pcs). Every client receives custom steel tooling cut strictly to their artwork, stored free of charge for 3 years in our Zhongshan mold vault so subsequent reorders pay $0 mold fees.

faqs.question: What base materials and manufacturing crafts are used on Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins?
faqs.answer: Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins is custom-engineered from Die-Struck Iron / Zinc Alloy using Recessed Soft Enamel Infused with Metallic Glitter, sized around 35×35×1.6mm at approximately 13g per unit (custom dimensions available).

faqs.question: Which electroplating colors and surface finishes are available for Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins?
faqs.answer: Standard factory surface options for this custom craft include Shiny Gold / Rose Gold / Black Nickel. Dual-tone masking plating and custom matte or clear protective lacquer coatings are also available upon request.

faqs.question: What backings, attachments, and accessories come with Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins?
faqs.answer: This custom format ships with Dual Rubber Clutches. Upgrade hardware options such as deluxe locking pin clutches, magnetic no-hole bar clasps, custom split rings, or velvet presentation boxes can be specified in your quote.

faqs.question: Can we get a free digital artwork proof before paying for tooling or samples?
faqs.answer: Yes. Send your vector logo (.AI, .EPS, .SVG, or vector .PDF) or rough sketch via our quote form or WhatsApp, and our engineering team will send a free 1:1 scaled digital production proof within 12 hours.

faqs.question: Can we order a physical pre-production sample of Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins before mass production?
faqs.answer: Yes. Pre-production physical samples take 7–10 business days (paid sample covers custom mold cutting to your design, plating, and enamel finishing; courier air freight is billed at carrier cost or via your DHL/FedEx account).

faqs.question: What is the bulk production lead time for Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins?
faqs.answer: Mass production for Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins completes in 8–12 Days after digital artwork proof or physical sample approval, followed by multi-point pre-shipment inspection for color accuracy, plating luster, and attachment security.

faqs.question: Does Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins meet US CPSIA, California Prop 65, and EU REACH safety standards?
faqs.answer: Yes. All raw metals, electroplating baths, and Pantone enamel pigments comply with US CPSIA (<90 ppm lead), California Prop 65, and EU REACH / EN 1811 nickel-release regulations.

faqs.question: What retail packaging upgrades are compatible with Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins?
faqs.answer: Beyond complimentary individual polybags, Custom Glitter Enamel Lapel Pins can be packaged onto custom printed 350gsm retail backing cards, sealed inside clear acrylic coin capsules, or presented in flocked velvet gift boxes.
